milestone.title: Unified harness registry for all install paths (make + mp + source)

intent.outcome: make install, make uninstall, mp install, and source-based installs all use the same harness registry, so there's one source of truth for where things go per harness.

problem.description: Currently make install, make uninstall, and mp install each have their own hardcoded paths with no shared registry. make install uses templates/harness/ directly, mp install has its own path logic in install.rs, and there's no single place to add a new harness. Before M51 can build the v2 install engine, the foundational harness registry needs to exist and be used by all install paths. Otherwise M51 will have to fight existing path logic scattered across the codebase.

in_scope: Create HarnessDescriptor struct in crates/mp/src/harness.rs (NOT mp-model — install paths are runtime concerns; mp-model stays a pure plan-data crate) with fields: id, display_name, convention_file_name, global_skill_dir, project_skill_dir (Option), agent_profile_dir, supports_global, supports_project. Ship a default_registry() with: opencode, cursor, claude-code, gemini, codex, windsurf, cline, pi.

Add `mp install --print-paths [--harness <id>] --format json` that emits registry paths (convention file, skill dir, profile dir, bin dir) as JSON — the Make<->Rust bridge, since a Makefile cannot import a Rust struct.
Refactor Makefile install/uninstall targets to consume `mp install --print-paths` JSON instead of hardcoded templates/harness/ paths.
Refactor crates/mp/src/install.rs to use harness.rs for all path lookups instead of hardcoded agents_skill_dir/cursor_skill_dir. Keep existing CLI flags, use the registry internally.
Refactor crates/mp/src/doctor.rs to use harness.rs for path lookups instead of inline path logic.
Ensure source-based installs (cargo build + manual copy) work with the registry.
Remove or deprecate templates/harness/ directory in favor of the code-based registry.
out_of_scope: Putting HarnessDescriptor in mp-model (install paths are runtime concerns, not plan data).
The v2 install CLI flags (--harness multi-select, --global, etc.) — that's M51's job.
Changing the behavior of existing install commands — only internal refactoring.
